digest.component_or_area: completion-verifier recovery stage and contractual guidance
propositions: Completion verification rejects valid operator-attested Gerrit and CI provenance recorded in ticket material after genuine-breadth request/tool exhaustion, emitting false-negative met=false despite concrete evidence present.

The remediation guidance at completion.py:48-65 promises concrete ticket-comment evidence will be considered on retry but omits the [operator-attested] tag prerequisite defined in completion_verifier.md and ADR 0043, creating a contract mismatch.
The defect is multi-file remediation-contract drift rather than evidence-gathering omission or truncation; current recovery and finalizer stages correctly carry tagged provenance into the decision.
An untagged external criterion cannot satisfy codebase-verifiable classification per intended strict-tag behavior, so the recorded rejection was intentional, not indicative of recovery loss.
